body:
PR185의 기존 651개 Route–SOC 제약을 더한 B2 ROOT를 사전등록 설정 그대로 native optimize **1회** 실행했다. ROOT는 900초 예산 안에 OPTIMAL로 완료됐지만, 독립 인증값이 기존 하한보다 약해 판정은 **B2_ROOT_NONMATERIAL**, Material Gate는 FAIL이다.

| 지표 | 결과 |
|---|---:|
| Runtime / Work | 210.22599983215332 s / 387.4427666794086 |
| Native LP objective | 0.5687138902579907 |
| Archived native LP 대비 차이 | +0.000001947264524737591 |
| 새 exact certified B2 LB | 0.5659508784310822 |
| 새 인증값 − 기존 LB | -0.002760731973838415 |
| 최종 valid global LB | 0.5687116104049206 — 기존 값 보존 |
| 최종 global LB 개선량 | 0 |
| 검증된 UB | 0.6284141956452488 — 기존 값 보존 |
| Global gap | 9.500515051068552% |

새 분수점은 651개 제약을 모두 만족한다. Scientific 1e-8 기준 fractional binary는 7,454→8,019개지만 1e-6 진단 기준에서는 둘 다 7,446개다. 원본 strict 행 replay는 residual 6.398198681978329e-8로 FAIL이므로 exact LP optimum의 상승·동일성이나 정수 incumbent라고 주장하지 않는다.

Raw Pi 부호 오류 20,566개를 거부하고 원시값을 보존했다. 별도 sign-cone multiplier의 exact finite-box LB를 독립 CSR-row dyadic 계산으로 재검증했다. 모든 306,040 finite-bound 항을 포함한 이 약한 하한은 PASS지만 native 목적값 상승을 인증하지 못했다. Native ObjBound는 채택하지 않았다. 인증 손실의 float 진단 분해에서는 injection_P/Q가 finite-box support 손실의 약 99.99955%를 차지한다.

PR185 exact HEAD `6d1d64beaf012d32ddf39245890785e3d8f01d4b`에 stacked Draft로 올린다. 기존 15개 구현과 71개 증거의 SHA를 두 작업공간에서 확인했으며, 원본 objective/ObjCon/axis/CSR/RHS/senses/bounds/types 및 실제 native transport를 검증했다. 20개 원본 정수 witness와 검증된 UB의 full physical replay를 통과했다.

독립 exact checker의 analytic 하한 및 네 가지 잘못된 certificate 거부 검사, 새 모듈 compile, 저장 raw/proof 재계산, SHA manifest 및 staged Git blob 일치, git diff --check를 통과했다. Native raw·barrier/presolve trajectory·peak RSS·분수 구조·수치 진단·한국어 보고서를 `docs/v42_m1_b2_root_validation_20261008/`에 저장했다. 실행 직전 resource gate는 PASS였지만 실행 중 외부 May12 pytest가 관측돼 archived 비교를 통제된 인과적 속도 향상으로 해석하지 않는다. 다른 작업·프로세스는 수정하지 않았다.

M1_ACCEPTED=false다. 추가 ROOT·새 cut·canary·production·downstream은 실행하지 않았다. 다음 행동은 **injection_P/Q의 원래 binding 등식으로 stationarity residual을 상쇄하는 exact multiplier repair 한 건을 optimize=0의 별도 실험으로 검증**하는 것만 추천하며, 이번에는 실행하지 않았다.

body:
May01's trajectory DW research could generate columns but did not complete a reusable CG loop or a stronger certified Global LB. This draft connects selected existing PR142/147/152 CG mechanics to the current full96 trajectory master, true-price admission, current-objective exact pricing coverage, and cumulative Native ledger.

The adapter preserves original grid/objective/fixed-input identities and power-of-two master transport. Discovery-only stabilization cannot authorize admission or certification. Pricing records raw Pi and exact RHS/box/rounding terms, rejects wrong signs, and independently rechecks same-unit saved duals under current prices and branch bounds. PR153 multi-column acceleration and PR157 early B&P remain disabled.

## Measured outcome

- Preserved published LB: **0.38895900867731903**, certified gain **0**, Global Gap **28.060570285386962%**.
- Registered pilot stopped after one MESS01 Discovery optimize: **5.23799991607666 Native seconds**, cumulative **141.40300178527832 seconds** including the unchanged prior 136.16500186920166-second ledger prefix.
- Existing catalog entries lacked optional `point_sha`; projection diagnostics incorrectly required it. The pilot stopped before Master optimization or new pricing certification.
- After source repair, read-only replay admitted four cached current-case candidates with negative exact true RC and numerical local feasibility. They were **not inserted into the pilot Master**. No Solver was rerun.
- Master remains the previous 12-column result 0.5406756909532953; no new DW certificate. Previous DW candidate -16.898190436665164 remains historical evidence, not a new bound.
- Full pricing closure and a rigorous formulation ceiling remain **NOT_PROVEN**; the 3% target needs LB 0.5244554202246624.

First-round diagnostics show effectively zero new lambdas with 553 changed dual rows, supporting degeneracy. Grid projections and critical-line contributions differ materially from seeds, so simple duplication or no network influence do not explain the unchanged objective. An upper-active seed's pre-update negative RC is accounted for separately.

## Validation and scope

Lightweight fixtures passed before the pilot; post-repair fixtures pass, including the actual old catalog schema, stop-latch/no Native replay, current true RC, bounded coverage, wrong certificates/axes rejection, preserved Native accounting, reversible scaling, and saved May01 MESS01 r01/MESS03 exact cross-dual regressions. No full regression suite.

See `docs/v42_m_stage_trajectory_hull/ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md`, `INTEGRATED_RESULT.md`, source provenance, gate, trial JSON and evidence manifest. Trial source and post-repair source are separately recorded. The stopped pilot is latched against automatic restart; latest Native ledger SHA is anchored to prevent budget reset.

B3 M1/M2 are NOT_RUN without current fixed inputs. No campaign, Supervisor, scheduled-task or Production operation, no Frozen scientific input modification, no PR202 change. This draft does **not** establish a material certified LB improvement.

body:
Source18r's full Root did not complete, so this independent pilot tests one fixed convex grid-weight vector against four literal full96 integer MESS physical models. It certifies **Global LB 0.11666465693783702**, frozen U4 UB 0.6760534504652341, **82.743279% gap**. Verdict: **VALID_GLOBAL_LB_NONMATERIAL**; further expansion is rejected.

Original FULL response/injection equalities, P/Q signs, grid correction and RHS are eliminated in exact rational arithmetic. Each vehicle retains every original single-owner row, bound, route binary, SOC, travel energy, mode, connection and PCS16 constraint. Shared/grid rows are dropped, proving the original feasible projection is contained in the four-domain product. A single frozen-U4 vector uses 16 distinct-slot critical faces with weight 1/16 each; no DW/CG/B&P or weight iteration.

All four models return OPTIMAL with local gap zero. Sequential Worker1/Threads1 native times are 8.091, 27.921, 8.934 and 12.146 seconds (total **57.092**, TimeLimit29 per unit). Peak RSS is **354.684 MiB**, peak private commit 1.44923 GiB. Exact objective-rounding box corrections and independent bound aggregation pass. Certification independently verifies model/inclusion/transport and trusts Gurobi's global-bound numerical contract; it is not an exact B&B proof trace or Actual AC certificate.

Validation: 7 symbolic tests, 3 independent corruption rejections, Native0, electrical/Forecast/fixed-AIDC provenance, native readback, local incumbent replay, and final independent certificate pass. Full-size C3A MILP/Root calls0, additional solver calls0, campaign calls0. Existing Source18r/U4/PR207 results and inputs are unchanged; PR147/203 numerical outputs are not reused.

The initial Unicode LogFile failure occurred before optimize (0 calls/0 seconds) and is preserved. Only an ASCII relative log path was repaired under a zero-Native guard. HOLD markers, Disabled schedules, PAUSED automations and worker absence remain unchanged. Controller status briefly varied by an OS tick, so continuous zero-CPU suspension is explicitly not certified; the final snapshot has all seven stopped.

Review `docs/v42_physical_global_lb_pilot/REPORT_KO.md`, `MATH_REVIEW_KO.md`, `INDEPENDENT_CERTIFICATE.json`, `FINAL_REVIEW_KO.md`, `FINAL_VALIDATION_SUMMARY.json` and `EVIDENCE_INDEX.json`. 정확한 모델 포함관계/반올림 인증과 **수치적 Gurobi ObjBound 계약**을 구분합니다. 독립 exact B&B trace 인증을 주장하지 않습니다. 축소 incumbent는 원본 FULL 가능해·새 UB·Actual PASS로 사용하지 않았습니다.

title: V42 B2: certify time-decomposed LB and 896-binary Window pilot

body:
Warm route-centered local branching improves PR219's Original FULL-verified moving UB from **0.5421769340794683 to 0.5398310226338695**. MESS03 retains three actual original-DAG moves and advances the last two departures from slots 69/81 to 64/77. Both BEST_GLOBAL_UB and BEST_MOVING_FEASIBLE_UB equal the new value.

- Additional reduction vs PR219: **0.002345911445598814**. Reduction vs historical N1: **0.006331107590355377**, meeting the absolute 0.005 material-improvement target.
- First accepted strict/material improvement: **229.208 cumulative new Native seconds**. New total: **724.821 seconds / 21 distinct models**, within the 1,800-second maximum. The preregistered nonduplicate model pool was exhausted; this does not mean all original route space was searched. Prior PR219 Native time is separate.
- The new solution keeps all four units' 384 Charge Modes and Pch/Pdis/Q/SOC free under the original bounds and all FULL Grid/PCS/SOC/ETA/energy rows. Route bounds and Node-only Hamming rows restrict the search. Center inclusion, a distinct moving DAG witness, flow/alias closure, source rows, and exact raw Start readback are independently checked before Optimize.
- Six complete-route ablations, nine primary local neighborhoods and six adaptive post-gain corridors are preserved. No Beam restart, cold N1/U4 run, unrestricted FULL B&B, or new LB optimization. Restricted ObjBound never becomes Global LB.
- Inherited K48 LB: **0.46498486997548166**; certified Global Gap: **13.864737209%**, above the 3% target. This is a verified matheuristic improvement, without a claim of global route optimality.

Validation: Native0 preparation and source/policy seal; all 21 actual Native readbacks and runtime/resource receipts; 27 passing Raw FULL replays and one rejected unrounded callback Raw; independent Original FULL repeat, ledger/signature/center/witness audits PASS. The accepted FINAL_RAW passes the original FULL validator without clipping, rounding, repairs, or tolerance changes. Threads=1 and one heavy worker; original sources, PR219 artifacts, B1/HOLD state and prior ledgers are preserved. ACTUAL_NOT_RUN.

Only new `tools/route_centered_lb1800/` and `docs/v42_b2_route_centered_local_branching1800/` files are added above exact PR219 HEAD `ca2c050c5481e64d560ed35f5a03e30c9fffb829`. Delivery index verifies exact staged bytes; whitespace check passes. The Korean report includes Q1–Q10, stage/iteration tables, actual 96-slot plan, critical Grid/rebound/PCS/SOC analysis, resource/numeric warnings and figures.

Report: `docs/v42_b2_route_centered_local_branching1800/ROUTE_CENTERED_LB1800_FINAL_KO.md`
title: V42 B2: PR219 warm local branching reaches verified moving UB 0.539831

body:
## 결과와 변경

IEEE123 B2 May01 Adaptive Beam–4-MESS Joint MILP의 반복 준비 과정에서 불변 원본 Alias를 매번 전개하던 비용을 Source/Case/Domain/정식화 SHA로 검증한 읽기 전용 정적 캐시로 줄였습니다. 후보마다 DAG·lambda·Node/Flow/Arc/Alias 연결, MIP Start, Native Readback, 원본 FULL Replay는 유지했습니다. PCS 스코어를 배열 연산으로 바꾸고 96슬롯 Multi-Critical Grid·SOC·Rebound 기반 후보와 실제 Joint 결과의 피드백을 평가했습니다.

네 차량 각각 STAY·단일 MOVE·복수 MOVE 후보를 선택하며, 경로와 384 Charge Mode 및 Pch/Pdis/Q/SOC를 한 MILP에서 공동 결정합니다. 이동 강제나 조합별 MILP 열거는 없습니다. Source18r Exact C3A+Dense의 원본 Grid·PCS16·ETA·이동에너지·종단 SOC·고정 AIDC·목적함수를 보존합니다. 추가된 도구와 증거만 제출하며 PR220 기준 소스는 수정하지 않습니다.

## 실측 결과

- 동일 Source/Case/Pool/Start 준비시간: 50.653초 → 27.203초, 23.450초(46.30%) 감소. 최초 캐시 생성 5.531초는 별도 기록했습니다. 전체 반복 속도 개선률로 환산하지 않습니다.
- 네 개의 서로 다른 동일 조건 Pool에서 Direct/EF Native 중앙값: 37.269초 / 42.547초. 최종 Backend DIRECT. 입력 Binary 9,354 → 416. Presolve/NNZ/Root/NodeCount/ObjBound/UB 발견 기록을 보존했습니다.
- V3 전체 반복 Wall 중앙값 204.436초, 확장 없는 일반 반복 중앙값 163.735초. 사전 준비한 첫 Pool 및 Beam 확장 비용을 별도로 기록했습니다.
- 같은 승인 실행의 Native: Pilot 63.642 + V2 956.926 + V3 769.629 = 1,790.197 / 1,800초. 예산 초기화 없이 안전 반환 여유로 종료했습니다.
- 25개 경로 Pool, 36 Native 호출, 35개 서로 다른 Raw의 독립 Original FULL Replay PASS. 모든 채택 UB는 FULL PASS입니다.
- BEST_GLOBAL_UB = BEST_MOVING_FEASIBLE_UB = 0.5398310226338695. PR220 대비 개선 0; 신규 개선해 발견시간 해당 없음.
- 기존 K48 Global LB 0.46498486997548166 유지, Global Gap 13.86473720854514%. 제한 MILP의 ObjBound는 Global LB로 사용하지 않았습니다.

## 검증 및 보존

독립 감사는 36개 모델의 원본 부분집합 포함성, 정확한 계수와 Raw Lift, Route/Node/Flow/Alias 정합성, Native Readback, MIP Start, Source SHA, 실제 Runtime 원장을 검증했습니다. Source·버전 변경 및 캐시 오염 거부, 스코어 동등성 회귀도 PASS입니다. Heavy Worker 1, Threads 1, RAM/Commit Gate 및 B1 보호를 유지했고 추가 LB Optimize·B1/B3/IEEE8500/다른 날짜/May 캠페인/Actual 실행은 하지 않았습니다.

Pilot의 조기 기각 기록과 기존 원장·Raw·Source SHA는 역사 자료로 보존하고 최종 보고서로 해석을 정정했습니다. V2→V3는 Worker가 없는 경계에서 동결·Native0·독립 Readback 후 전환했습니다. 동일 모델 재평가는 Signature로 막고, 다른 정식화의 같은 Pool 비교만 Benchmark로 구분했습니다.

최종 보고서: `docs/v42_b2_adaptive_perf_v3/ADAPTIVE_JOINT_FINAL_KO.md`

핵심 증거: `FINAL_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.json`, `ALL_SESSION_NATIVE_RUNTIME_LEDGER.json`, `TIMING_ACCOUNTING.json`, `FORMULATION_COMPARISON.json`, `DELIVERY_ARTIFACT_INDEX.json` 및 96슬롯 계획 CSV/Raw/Native Readback. 제출 파일은 Git Blob과 원본 파일 바이트를 비교했습니다.

이번 표본은 준비 병목 개선을 보이지만 전체 알고리즘의 UB 개선 또는 원본 DAG의 개선 불가능성을 증명하지 않습니다.
title: V42 B2: cached Adaptive Beam–4-MESS Joint MILP with preserved 1800s budget

body:
May01 lost its validated PR220 moving incumbent when the production adapter replaced RAW_REL with a fresh stationary point. The winning three-MOVE path was absent from all generated pools; its original FULL Raw still passes the current numerically identical case at rho_max 0.5398310226338695.

This Draft adds a date/physical-contract-bound incumbent registry with fresh FULL replay, monotone global/moving UB retention, and pinned verified paths. A bounded final-admission LP redispatches all four vehicles over the 96-slot critical context to address the reproduced STAY-reference scoring counterexample. It is a heuristic continuous-mode relaxation and never supplies a FULL UB or global LB. The original Exact C3A+Dense joint MILP, 384 charge-mode binaries and physical constraints are preserved.

Validation: 17 regression tests; current Original FULL replay PASS; repaired Beam retains the complete winner and all four STAY/single/multiple-MOVE choices; Native0 exact CSR/domain/Start/link readback PASS (416 binaries, Start residual 9.95e-11). No new Gurobi Optimize or Presolve calls. Mathematical Start inclusion is verified; solver Start processing during Optimize is not claimed.

B2 workers/supervisor are stopped and scheduled redispatch disabled. May01/May02 measured Native usage remains 1003.501/943.402 seconds. B2 and B3 M remain HOLD; B0/B1 and PR221 research files are preserved. This Draft does not activate a new campaign or reset any budget.

See docs/v42_b2_stationary_repair_20261013/REPORT_KO.md for the 12-part diagnosis, physical/provenance comparison, raw evidence and rollout limitations.
